name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: An Operator Black context menu with a pointer anchor, technical shortcuts, and mint selection check

variables.label: Items
variables.description: Comma-separated menu item labels matched to rows by position. Blank entries keep the authored label.

variables.label: Active item
variables.description: Which item is highlighted, counting from 1. Out-of-range values clamp.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token behind the check mark and the inset bar on the active item.

variables.label: Theme
variables.description: Token set for the menu: dark surfaces or light ones.
